profile.headline: SWE @ Microsoft | Morehouse Man
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer at Microsoft, currently on the Game Details and Frontend Platform team, where I focus on building delightful game details experiences across our various storefronts and endpoints. 🎮

A lot of my growth came from the BVCC Software Engineering Track and being involved with CODEHOUSE, NSBE, and several other organizations, where I learned the value of teamwork, mentorship, and having a strong community around you. 🤝

I care a lot about helping more young Black students get into tech. For me, it’s not just about my own career but also about sharing what I know, mentoring, and doing what I can to make the industry more inclusive. On a broader note, I love to provide help and guidance to anyone who may need/want it! 🌱

Always open to connecting as well!! You can reach me here or at masonbrown0602@gmail.com 📬

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Game Details and Frontend Platform team, focusing on building delightful game details experiences across our various storefronts/endpoints!

positions.title: NSBE Collegiate & Chapter Member
positions.description:
•	A national organization dedicated to empowering Black engineers through community building, professional development, and academic excellence, fostering the next generation of innovators and leaders in STEM at scale. 
~ AUC Chapter

positions.title: ColorStack Member
positions.description: •	A tech nonprofit cultivating the strongest cross-campus community of its kind to deliver community building, academic support, and career development opportunities at scale.

positions.title: ITSMF College Mentoring Program
positions.description: •	As a 2025 ITSMF Mentee, I'm engaged in a mentoring program focused on empowering emerging tech professionals through community building, career development, and hands-on guidance, fostering the next generation of innovators and leaders in technology.

company.name: ITSMF - Information Technology Senior Management Forum

positions.title: NSLS Member
positions.description:
•	The largest leadership honor society in the United States, dedicated to helping students achieve their personal and professional goals. 
•	Through leadership training, networking opportunities, and community-building events, the NSLS empowers members to create positive change and become effective leaders in their fields.

company.name: The National Society of Leadership and Success (NSLS)

positions.title: Community Member
positions.description:
•	Received advanced training in various tech-related fields, including information technology, computer science, human interaction, and UX/UI design.
•	Strengthened leadership skills through hands-on professional development workshops focused on public speaking, problem-solving, and team-building.
•	Attended panel discussions, fireside chats, and other networking events with leading tech companies such as PayPal, Twitter, Google, and more.

positions.title: Morehouse Accelerated Academic Program
positions.description:
•	Dynamic six-week academic enhancement and college readiness program.
•	Offered incoming freshmen a challenging and rewarding academic experience.
•	Strengthened the participants' writing proficiency, study habits, critical thinking, and time management capabilities.

positions.title: BVCC Software Engineering Track Cohort Member
positions.description: •	An intensive program designed to enhance and refine software engineering skills through hands-on projects, mentorship, and professional development, preparing participants for success in the tech industry.

positions.title: Clean Energy & Environmental Justice Ambassador Fellow
positions.description:
•	Engaged in weekly training sessions and informational seminars; fostering acquisition of essential professional competencies and brought.
•	Enabled cultivation of vital professional skills and interaction with industry leaders in various sustainability and environmental justice professions.
•	Further and expanded my network within a new industry. 
•	Enhanced professional development and career readiness through increased emphasis on sustainability seminars.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Completed a 12-week internship at the Redmond Microsoft Campus.
•	Worked under the Xbox team to build an AI-Generation feature to help streamline and improve the store listing experience for game publishers coming to the Xbox platform.
•	Engaged in Software Engineering (SWE) work throughout the summer.
•	Specialized in Back-End development, AI architecture, LLM design & development, and services work. 
•	Helped create a POC (proof of concept) for a feature that will enhance the store listing experience, increase the retention rate of game publishers for Xbox, and simplify the overall store listing experience. 
•	Grew and enhanced my network within Microsoft between interns and full-time employees.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Large Language Models (LLM) · JSON · HTML · Postman API · Testing Services

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Completed a 12 Week Internship at the Redmond Microsoft Campus.
•	Worked under the Xbox team to build a store preview experience for game publishers on the Xbox platform.
•	Engaged in Software Engineering (SWE) work throughout the summer.
•	Specialized in Front-end development, web architecture, client-side experiences, and some Back-end services work. 
•	Developed a feature that will enhance customer experience, increase the retention rate of game publishers for Xbox, and simplify the overall publishing experience. 
•	Grew and enhanced my network within Microsoft between interns and full-time employees.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Coding · C# · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Redux.js · VCS - Git

positions.title: Google HBCU/HSI Summer Tech Immersion
positions.description:
•	A 3-week developmental program for CS students entering their second year of college that focuses on technical interview skills and professional development.
•	Throughout the program, students will attend virtual sessions with Google engineers that highlight best practices for technical interviewing and deep dives into fundamental CS concepts.
•	Through these sessions, students will have the opportunity to network with a wide array of Googlers and other CS students.
•	Students will also participate in a series of mock technical interviews with Google engineers and resume reviews with Google recruiters.

positions.title: Microsoft Explore Intern (SWE + PM)
positions.description:
•	Completed a 12 Week Internship at the Redmond Microsoft Campus.
•	Worked under the Xbox team to build an improved search experience on the Xbox.com Storefront.
•	Engaged in Product Management(PM) and Software Engineering(SWE) work in the development.
•	Specialized in Back-end Services, architecture, and logic development.
•	Developed a product that increased Click Through Conversions, result relevancy, customer satisfaction, and revenue.
•	Constructed a solid network within Microsoft between interns and full-time employees.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Outlook · C# · Fiddler · VCS - Git · Microsoft PowerPoint · Postman API · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Google's Coding Challenge
positions.description:
•	Displayed my ability to effectively code and solve problems in a low-pressure environment. 
Engaged in a collaborative environment to work through coding prompts.
•	This was a 2.5-hour coding competition between HBCUs & HSIs across the country.

positions.title: Microsoft Tech Resilience Program
positions.description:
•	Microsoft Tech Resilience is a 6-week mentorship program that pairs first-year CS students with trained industry professionals to help teach the necessary non-tech skills.
•	Students developed new skill sets such as active listening and practical communication skills that will help them effectively traverse the tech industry.

positions.title: Information Technology Desktop Support Intern
positions.description:
•	Configured laptops, desktops and tablets with a custom image build
•	Replaced defective hard drives
•	Installed additional ram in laptops and desktops
•	Shipped/Received Equipment
•	Tracked/Assigned hardware and consumable assets in ServiceNow
•	Uploaded user profiles as part of a Next Generation Hardware Replacement project 
•	Verified the scheduled return date for leased equipment
